parameters.description: Operation type.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description:
XML command string. Required for `type=op`, `type=commit`, and `type=user-id`.

Examples:
- `type=op`: `<show><system><info/></system></show>`
- `type=commit`: `<commit></commit>` or `<commit><partial>...</partial></commit>`
- `type=user-id`: `<uid-message><payload><login>...</login></payload></uid-message>`

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Config action. Required when `type=config`.

parameters.name: xpath
parameters.description:
XPath expression targeting the configuration node. Required for most `type=config` actions.

Example: `/config/devices/entry[@name='localhost.localdomain']/vsys/entry[@name='vsys1']/address`

parameters.name: element
parameters.description:
XML element to set or edit. Used with `type=config&action=set` or `action=edit`.

Example: `<entry name='test-addr'><ip-netmask>10.0.0.1/32</ip-netmask></entry>`

parameters.name: newname
parameters.description: New name for the object. Used with `type=config&action=rename`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Insertion point for move operations. Used with `type=config&action=move`.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: Destination rule name for move operations. Used with `type=config&action=move` when `where=before` or `where=after`.

parameters.name: log-type
parameters.description: Log type to retrieve. Required when `type=log`.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
Log filter query in PAN-OS log query syntax. Used with `type=log`.

Example: `(addr.src in 10.0.0.0/8)`

parameters.name: nlogs
parameters.description: Number of log entries to retrieve (max 5000). Used with `type=log`.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of log entries to skip (for pagination). Used with `type=log`.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: Log retrieval direction. Used with `type=log`.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Export/import category. Required when `type=export` or `type=import`.

200.description:
XML response. The structure varies by operation type.

- **Success**: `<response status='success'>...</response>`
- **Error**: `<response status='error'><msg>...</msg></response>`
- **Commit job**: `<response status='success'><result><job>1234</job></result></response>`

400.description: Bad request — malformed XPath, invalid command syntax, or missing required parameter

401.description: Authentication failed — invalid or missing API key

post.summary: Push committed configuration to managed devices
post.description: Pushes the last committed Panorama configuration to managed firewalls using the Panorama XML API (commit-all). Authentication is handled automatically via the X-PAN-KEY header (PAN-OS 9.0+). To push to all device groups use `<commit-all><shared-policy></shared-policy></commit-all>`; to scope to a specific device group use `<commit-all><shared-policy><device-group><entry name="my-dg"/></device-group></shared-policy></commit-all>`.

200.description: Commit-all response. Panorama returns XML. A successful push returns status='success' with a job ID. Poll the job status to track completion.

hostname.description: Hostname or IP address of the Panorama server
